lane.stopInProgress: Protection is still being stopped — please wait
lane.cancelledDraining: The cancelled operation is still finishing
lane.preemptFailed: The cancelled operation could not be finished
lane.stateRefusesStart: The tunnel state does not allow a new start
lane.higherPriority: A higher-priority operation is still running
lane.confirmationMissing: Connection not confirmed: the protection state could not be verified
lane.cleanupUnconfirmed: Stop not confirmed: the tunnel or its settings may still be active
lane.maintenanceRefused: Turn protection off before network maintenance
lane.maintenanceBusy: Network maintenance is running — please wait

server.none: No server selected. Open “Servers” and add a subscription or a key.
server.unavailable: The selected server is not in the server list. Refresh the subscription or pick another server in “Servers”.

soft.rollbackBeforeStart: Could not turn Proxy mode off before starting the tunnel
soft.applyFailed: Could not apply the Proxy mode settings
soft.envRollbackFailed: Could not restore the proxy settings. Retry the network restore.

outcome.softModeSwitch: Proxy mode was turned off before another mode started
outcome.timeout: Protection start timed out — the connection was stopped
outcome.preempted: The connection was interrupted by a higher-priority operation
outcome.failed: The protection state was not confirmed — the connection was stopped
outcome.failover: Connections to the server failed — the connection moved to another server of the same group
outcome.failoverRestarts: The VPN engine stopped and restarts did not bring the connection back — it moved to another server of the same group

connected.title: Protection on
connected.body: All traffic goes through the VPN.
connected.bodyListed: Selected apps go through the VPN.

restored.title: VPN is back
restored.body: The internet goes through the VPN again.
restored.bodyListed: Selected apps go through the VPN again.

keptBlocked.title: Connection stopped — traffic stays blocked
keptBlocked.body: The server did not pass the connection check. The firewall keeps blocking traffic so your IP does not leak. Turn protection on again or off.

keptSoftBlocked.title: Connection stopped — programs stay blocked
keptSoftBlocked.body: The server did not pass the connection check. The system proxy still points at the stopped engine: programs that use it get no connection until you turn protection on again or off. Other programs connect directly.

paused.title: Internet paused
paused.body: The VPN is reconnecting. Programs wait for it, or choose Continue without VPN.
paused.manual: Automatic reconnect is off. Press Connect, or choose Continue without VPN.

keyRejected.title: The server rejects the key
keyRejected.body: The internet is paused. Update the key or the subscription, or choose Continue without VPN.

reconnecting.title: The VPN is reconnecting
reconnecting.body: Programs go through the VPN again as soon as it is back.
reconnecting.direct: Meanwhile programs connect directly, without the VPN.
reconnecting.other: Meanwhile programs go through the other VPN.

failover.title: Server changed
failover.body: Connections to “{{from}}” failed. Switched to “{{name}}”, another server of the same group.
failover.bodyRestarts: The VPN engine stopped on “{{from}}” and restarts did not bring the connection back. Switched to “{{name}}”, another server of the same group.
failover.bodySwitched: Switched to “{{name}}”, another server of the same group.

internalError.title: Internal error
internalError.body: The protection state is not confirmed
